definitions.title: Geometric Definitions and Standard Forms of Conic Sections
definitions.statement: Conic sections are curves formed by intersecting a double right circular cone with a plane. Characterized universally by eccentricity e = PF / PD (distance to focus divided by distance to directrix): e = 0 (circle), 0 < e < 1 (ellipse), e = 1 (parabola), e > 1 (hyperbola).
conditions: a > b > 0 for ellipse, c^2 = a^2 - b^2; c^2 = a^2 + b^2 for hyperbola
definitions.explanation: Unifies planetary orbits (Kepler's First Law) and optical reflection properties.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Eccentricity e classifies all conic sections.
